progress.title: Production progress
progress.description: Completion and lateness of work orders
progress.caliber:
Work orders released or later (drafts and cancelled ones excluded) whose planned start (or creation time when not planned) falls in the period.
Completion = completed ÷ planned; completed is the good quantity of the last operation, defects are summed over all operations, stocked is the quantity already put into stock.
Late: has a planned end, and is not finished past the planned end, or finished after the planned end; judged at the statistics time.

wip.title: Work in process
wip.description: Current quantity in process at each operation
wip.caliber:
A snapshot at the statistics time: work orders in progress or paused that started before the end date; the start date does not affect it.
WIP = good quantity of the previous operation − (good + defects reported at this operation), at least 0, i.e. passed from the previous operation but not yet reported here.
The first operation has no material input records, so its WIP is 0; the planned quantity not yet reported there is shown as Pending input.

yield.title: Yield and first pass yield
yield.description: Good quantity and first pass yield of reports
yield.caliber:
Reports in the period that are not cancelled (by report time).
Yield = good ÷ reported (good + defects).
First pass yield: for each work order, the product of the yields of its operations reported in the period, averaged over work orders weighted by the reported quantity of the earliest reported operation (the input).
Weekly (Monday to Sunday) and monthly figures are merged from daily data; periods without reports show -.

defect.title: Defect Pareto
defect.description: Defects ranked by category to find the main sources
defect.caliber:
Defect records registered in the period (by registration time) from reports, inspections and manual entries, handled or not.
Defect records have no separate defect type or cause; they can be grouped by operation, level, source, disposition or product.
Sorted by quantity in descending order; the cumulative share is computed from the cumulative quantity, and the dashed line marks 80%.

downtime.title: Downtime
downtime.description: Count and duration of andon stoppages
downtime.caliber:
Stoppages: andon events at the line-stop level or with a downtime reason, by report time.
The duration is the downtime recorded when the event is resolved (from report to resolution); unresolved events are counted but have no duration, and are shown as Unresolved.
Average = downtime ÷ number of resolved events.

workhour.title: Working hours
workhour.caliber:
Reports in the period that are not cancelled.
The actual working time entered with the report is used; when not entered but start and end times exist, their difference is used; otherwise no time is counted and the report is counted under Reports without time.
Time per unit = total time ÷ good quantity.

team.title: Team performance
team.description: Output, yield and output per person of each team
team.caliber:
Reports in the period that are not cancelled, grouped by the team recorded on the report; reports without a team are shown separately.
Output is the reported quantity (good + defects), yield = good ÷ output, and hours follow the Working hours report.
People are those who reported in the team (distinct); good per person = good ÷ people, good per hour = good ÷ hours.
